user.title: Connect your Cync account
user.description: Enter the email and password you use for the GE / Savant Cync app.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate your Cync account
reauth_confirm.description: Your saved Cync sign-in is no longer valid. Re-enter your Cync password to reconnect. If devices remain unavailable afterward, also re-authenticate the official Cync app (see the integration's troubleshooting notes).

otp.title: Two-factor code
otp.description: Cync emailed you a one-time code. Enter it below.

reconfigure.title: Re-authenticate your Cync account
reconfigure.description: Sign in to Cync again to refresh the connection - no need to delete and re-add the integration. Use this when devices are stuck unavailable even though the connection looks healthy (a stale Cync account session). Re-enter your Cync password below.

error.invalid_otp: That code didn't work. Check your email and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Cync cloud. Please try again.

abort.already_configured: This Cync account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: Those credentials are for a different Cync account than the one being reauthenticated.

init.title: Options
init.description: Enable "assume available" if devices are stuck unavailable in Home Assistant while working in the Cync app - it keeps them controllable whenever the cloud connection is up. Local control (optional) runs a local server so Cync devices can be controlled without internet; it requires pointing cm.gelighting.com at Home Assistant via DNS, which the integration can do automatically if you use AdGuard Home (enter the AdGuard Home address including its port; the default admin port is 3000). Local control is experimental; the cloud connection keeps working regardless.

data.assume_available: Assume devices are available when connected (ignore per-device online status)
data.host_ip: Home Assistant IP address (that devices should connect to)
data.manage_adguard: Automatically manage the AdGuard Home DNS rewrite

error.host_ip_required: Enter Home Assistant's IP address to enable local control.
error.adguard_url_required: Enter the AdGuard Home URL to let the integration manage DNS.
error.adguard_cannot_connect: Could not reach AdGuard Home at that URL.
